GOODSDESC_HOSTINGITEM:
A crystalline pendant tuned by DSSeamlessCoop.

Creates a Bonfire session with seamless co-op, shared progression,
removed fog barriers, and automatic server routing.
GOODSDESC_JOININGITEM:
A stone pendant carrying a Bonfire signal.

Joins another DSSeamlessCoop world from anywhere and keeps the
session alive through deaths, bosses, and area clears.
GOODSDESC_BREAKINITEM:
A blasphemous pendant with a hostile pull.

Invades an eligible DSSeamlessCoop session when invasions are
enabled by the host.
GOODSDESC_LEAVINGITEM:
A rusted pendant marked by the old fire.

Leaves the current Bonfire session and returns to your own world.
GOODSDESC_GAMERULECHANGEITEM:
An ominous tome maintained by DSSeamlessCoop.

Changes session rules such as scaling and friendly-fire behavior.
